acceptedAdvisories.rationale: No patched release exists (advisory lists patched <0.0.0). Build-time-only transitive dependency of the Docusaurus docs toolchain (update-notifier > got > cacheable-request); runs only during the docs build's update check against the npm registry and is not shipped in any published package runtime tree. Reassess when a fixed release or a Docusaurus upgrade drops update-notifier.

No patched release exists (3.0.3 is the latest; advisory lists patched <0.0.0). Developer-tooling-only transitive dependency of @changesets/cli (micromatch) that globs first-party workspace paths; not shipped in any published package runtime tree. Reassess when braces publishes a fix.

resolvedAdvisories.action: 2026-10-08 advisory wave: pin every transitive package with a patched release through root pnpm overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml (shell-quote 1.12.0, joi 17.13.8, sharp 0.35.5, tinypool 2.1.2 scoped to @docusaurus/core, seroval 1.6.3, proxy-addr 2.0.8, compression 1.8.2, source-map-js 1.2.2, fast-uri 3.1.7, undici 7.29.1/8.10.2, brace-expansion 1.1.20/5.0.11, image-size 2.0.3, svgo 3.3.5, browserslist 4.28.7, js-yaml 4.3.2/3.15.2, devalue 5.9.3, nanoid 3.3.18) and upgrade the Next.js example to 16.3.8. seroval also reached the published entity-graph-solid package through solid-js, so that pin is a runtime fix, not docs hygiene.
Upgrade Next.js to 16.2.12 and use root pnpm overrides for PostCSS 8.5.25 and Sharp 0.35.0 because Next 16.2.12 still declares vulnerable exact/ranged transitive releases.
Upgrade @tanstack/react-router to 1.170.18 so router-core resolves patched seroval.
Remove the shadcn scaffolding CLI from application production dependencies; generated components do not import the CLI at runtime.

policy: Every active critical/high production advisory must be remediated or have a time-bounded acceptance with an owner and rationale. Lower severities remain visible and are not described as zero risk.
